title: Non gen-AI 'hacks' that use your own voice and math to create voiceovers/music
author: YosemiteCalamity
selftext:
[https://imgur.com/a/d1uKYxE](https://imgur.com/a/d1uKYxE)  
  
So no gen-AI, just my voice changed via math for the 'voice acting'.

And then my voice 'humming' changed into celo notes via math - no gen-AI.

Anyway, just saying. Music/voice acting is very difficult for indie dev.

The tools I made were custom (created with AI, just 'ask it'). Make your own version with AI from open-source, and you'll have plausible 'multiple voices' and also 'music' from your own voice, sans gen-AI!

So basically I'm saying, use gen-AI to make a tool that allows your human self to voice act and sing etc, and just adjusts the tone of it, so it's kosher.

Listen to the sounds. I'm not a 'good' voice actor, yet the math converted the 'voice acting' into plausible variants.

Also for singing, I've unashamedly included my 'yodelling' - really just average at best. The tool converted it to a MIDI (which is music sheet), then from there you can pick an instrument and it will mathematically 'map' it to a instrument. Here a cello.

Look, I'm just trying to help out and make everything seem 'doable'.

We will not get away with pure gen-AI for art, but we can use AI to create tools that convert our own human 'stuff' into voices and music etc without gen AI being involved.
